title: Mitrata
synopsis: A story of three friends and the bond that holds them together through changing phases of life — the banter, the quieter moments, and the friendship that stays.

synopsis_lang.en: A story of three friends and the bond that holds them together through changing phases of life — the banter, the quieter moments, and the friendship that stays.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 這是三個朋友的故事，也是那條貫穿人生變遷、將他們牢牢連在一起的紐帶——嬉笑打鬧、靜默相伴，以及那份一直都在的友情。

cast: Viraj Ghelani, Deep Vaidya, Vishal Parekh
